description: This file defines a utility class CacheDirective for parsing and creating cache directives compliant with RFC 2616. It includes methods to handle 'max-age' and 'no-cache' directives, provide string representations, and evaluate cache permissions.

classes.name: CacheDirective
classes.description: A helper class for parsing and creating HTTP cache directives such as 'max-age' and 'no-cache' as per RFC 2616.

methods.name: maxAgeDirective
methods.description: Creates a new max-age cache directive with the specified maximum age in seconds.

methods.name: noCacheDirective
methods.description: Creates a 'no-cache' directive indicating caching is not allowed.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Parses a string directive into a CacheDirective object, returning null if parsing fails.

methods.name: isCachingAllowed
methods.description: Returns whether caching is permitted based on the directive.

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the maximum age in seconds that the cache directive specifies.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the cache directive, suitable for use in HTTP headers.
